probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
(Currently Amended) Claim 1: A method of treating a brain, comprising: inserting an elongated device into the brain to create a path; radially expanding the device to create a working channel along the path; and introducing a medical element into the working channel, wherein the medical element is a medicament, to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 1, further comprising creating an opening in a cranium, and inserting the elongated device through the opening, wherein the elongated device is inserted between tissue layers within the brain.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 1, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers within the brain, wherein the elongated device is configured to create a path through the tissue layers.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1, wherein the medical element is a medicament delivered through the working channel to perform a medical procedure on the brain.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: A method of treating a tissue, comprising: placing an elongated device into the tissue to create a path; radially expanding the device against the tissue to radially displace the tissue along the path; radially reinforcing the device against the tissue; and introducing a medical element through the device, wherein the medical element is a medicament, to perform a medical procedure on the tissue.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The method of claim 7, further comprising inserting the elongated device between tissue layers, wherein the elongated device is configured to create a path through the tissue layers.
